Cheesecake In A Glass
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:35pm

Ingredients




20 vanilla wafers
3 tablespoons melted butter
2 pkg. (8 oz. each) cream cheese, room temperature
2 tablespoons sugar
2/3 cup sour cream
1 cup your choice canned pie filling or sliced fresh fru

Preparation

1 In electric blender or food processor, crush cookies to make fine crumbs. Put in bowl and mix in butter. Press crumb mixture into containers, on bottom and part way up the sides; set aside. 2 In bowl beat cheese, sugar and juice, then sour cream. Spoon over crumbs. Chill 1 hour. Top with fruit and serve.
